subject: website
name: ERC-8213
summary: The ERC-8213 explainer, a static Next.js page about showing digests of signed data and calldata. Its source is public (MIT, PatrickAlphaC/erc8213, whose homepage is this site). It makes no request beyond its own files: digests are computed in the browser, and the links to other sites, Cyfrin Tools included, are ordinary links the reader follows.
